title: Sr Specialist, EH&S
description:
We are seeking an experienced Sr Specialist, EH&S to drive Environment, Health, and Safety excellence at our plastics masterbatch manufacturing facility in India. This strategic leadership role is responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance, building a world-class safety culture, and implementing robust environmental management systems while enabling safe and sustainable manufacturing operations..

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Safety Management**

* Ensure compliance with **Factories Act 1948**, state factory rules, and all applicable safety regulations
* Lead comprehensive safety programs: Permit-to-Work, LOTOTO, confined space, working at heights, machine guarding
* Implement & Maintain **Process Safety Management (PSM)** for polymer compounding, twin-screw extrusion, and strand pelletizing operations
* Manage incident investigations using root cause analysis; drive corrective actions to closure
* Develop and deliver safety training programs; build behavioral-based safety (BBS) culture
* Maintain OSHA-equivalent recordkeeping; target zero lost-time injuries (LTI)
* Manage fire safety, emergency preparedness, and Emergency Response Team (ERT)
* Conduct industrial hygiene assessments (noise, dust, chemical vapors, ergonomics) and implement controls
* Lead contractor safety management from pre-qualification through performance monitoring

**Environmental Compliance & Management**

* Ensure compliance with **Environment Protection Act 1986**, Air/Water Acts, and Hazardous Waste Management Rules
* Obtain and maintain environmental **Consent to Operate (CTO)** from State Pollution Control Board (SPCB)
* Manage air emissions compliance: stack monitoring, pollution control equipment for extruders and DG sets
* Oversee wastewater treatment plant (ETP/STP) operations and discharge compliance
* Implement hazardous waste management: segregation, authorized storage, SPCB-authorized disposal
* Conduct mandatory environmental monitoring and submit statutory reports (Form V, TRI, Tier II, waste returns)
* Drive sustainability initiatives: energy/water conservation, waste reduction, recycling programs
* Manage spill prevention and emergency response for raw materials and chemicals

**Regulatory Compliance & Audit Management**

* Maintain strong relationships with Factory Inspector, SPCB/CPCB, Fire Department, and regulatory authorities
* Coordinate statutory inspections and resolve notices/show-cause orders professionally
* Plan and conduct internal EHS compliance audits, support corporate and customer audits
* Implement and maintain **RC14001:2023, ISO 14001:2015** (Environmental) and **ISO 45001** (Occupational Health & Safety) management systems
* Ensure timely renewal of all licenses, permits, and authorizations

**Strategic Leadership & Team Management**

* Develop annual EHS strategy, goals, and budget aligned with business objectives
* Chair Plant Safety Committee; lead monthly EHS performance reviews with leadership
* Manage and develop EHS team (Safety Officers, Environment Officer, EHS Coordinator)
* Establish and monitor EHS KPIs: TRIR, LTIFR, environmental incidents, compliance metrics
* Drive continuous improvement and benchmark against industry best practices
* Serve as primary EHS advisor to Plant Manager and site leadership team
* Other duties as assigned.

**Physical/Environmental. Demands**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; use hands to finger, handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee is occasionally required to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 50 lbs. Specific vision abilities required by this job may include close vision, color vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally exposed to moving mechanical parts, toxic or caustic chemicals and fumes or airborne particles. The noise level in the work environment ranges from normal office noise levels to loud.

**Scope**

Manufacturing Plant.

**Education & Certifications**  
**Essential:**

* Bachelor's degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Chemical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Safety, or related field
* **Diploma in Industrial Safety (DIS)** from recognized institution, OR
* **NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC),** OR
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP/ASP) from BCSP

**Preferred:**

* Master's degree in EHS-related discipline
* RC14001:2023, ISO 14001/45001 Lead Auditor certification
* Graduate Diploma in Industrial Safety & Health (GDis) from NIST Vadodara

**One of the following is mandatory:**

* Diploma in Industrial Safety (DIS) from recognized institution
* Graduate Diploma in Industrial Safety & Health (GDis) from NIST Vadodara
* NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) or higher
* Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Associate Safety Professional (ASP) from BCSP

**Experience**  
**Must Have:**

* **10-12 years** of progressive EHS experience in manufacturing/industrial environment
* **5-7 years** in EHS leadership/management role
* **Proven experience in plastics/polymer processing, chemical manufacturing, or compounding industry**
* Strong knowledge of Indian EHS statutory compliance (Factories Act, EPA, Air/Water Acts, Waste Management Rules)
* Experience managing SPCB/CPCB inspections, environmental consents, and permit renewals
* Demonstrated track record of driving safety culture transformation and reducing incident rates
* Experience with incident investigations, root cause analysis, and CAPA management

**Preferred:**

* Multinational manufacturing environment experience,
* ISO 14001/45001 implementation experience,
* Process Safety Management (PSM) in chemical operations,
* Customer EHS audit management (automotive, FMCG, packaging industries),
* Experience in unionized manufacturing environments
* ISO 14001:2015 Lead Auditor Certification
* ISO 45001:2018 Lead Auditor Certification
* Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) or Associate Industrial Hygienist (AIH)
* Process Safety Management (PSM) Certification
* First Aid Instructor / CPR/AED Certification

**Technical Knowledge & Skills**  
**Indian Statutory Compliance:**

* Factories Act 1948 and State Factory Rules,
* Environment Protection Act 1986 and Rules,
* Air/Water/Hazardous Waste/Plastic Waste Management Rules,
* National Building Code (NBC) for fire safety,
* SPCB/CPCB consent management and reporting

**Technical Expertise:**

* Process safety for polymer compounding, extrusion, pelletizing,
* Hazard identification and risk assessment (HIRA, PHA, HAZOP),
* Industrial hygiene monitoring (dust, noise, chemical exposure),
* Incident investigation methodologies (5-Why, Fishbone, RCA),
* Permit-to-Work, LOTOTO, confined space entry systems,
* Fire safety, emergency response planning,
* Environmental monitoring, sampling, and reporting,
* Contractor safety management

**Leadership & Communication:**

* Strategic thinking and change management, Strong presentation and training delivery skills, Excellent written communication (English and Hindi), Stakeholder management and influencing skills, Team building and development

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**  
**Safety Metrics:**

* Total Recordable Injury Rate (TRIR), Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate (LTIFR), Near-miss reporting rate, Safety training completion

**Environmental Metrics:**

* Environmental incidents/violations, Consent compliance rate, Waste reduction, Energy/water consumption

**Compliance:**

* Regulatory violations/fines, Audit findings closure, Permit renewals

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

* **Location:** Manufacturing plant with 60-70% time on production floor
* **Exposure:** Noise, heat, dust, chemical vapors, industrial hazards
* **Physical Requirements:** Walking, climbing stairs/ladders, wearing PPE (respirators, safety shoes, hard hat)
* **Schedule**: Monday-Saturday; 24/7 on-call for emergencies
* **Travel:** 10-15% (regulatory offices, corporate, training)

**SPECIAL AUTHORITIES**

**Stop Work Authority:** Absolute authority to stop any unsafe work activity that poses imminent danger, superseding production priorities.  
**Decision-Making Authority:** Independent authority on EHS policy enforcement, incident investigations, permit approvals, contractor qualifications, and corrective actions.

title: Windows System Administrator-L2
description:
**Job Title: Windows System Administrator – L2**

**Location:** Vadodara, Gujarat (On-Site)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Permanent

We are looking for an experienced Windows System Administrator – L2 with 3–5 years of experience in IT infrastructure and technical support.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage and troubleshoot Windows Servers, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and Group Policy.
* Provide L2 technical support and handle escalated incidents.
* Administer Microsoft 365, Azure, and basic AWS environments.
* Support networking, VPNs, firewalls, VMware/Hyper-V, backups, and disaster recovery.
* Perform server patching, security updates, and PowerShell automation.
* Maintain technical documentation and ensure SLA compliance.

**Required Skills:**

* Strong Windows Server administration and troubleshooting skills.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, networking, and virtualization.
* Knowledge of PowerShell, backup solutions, and cloud technologies.
* Excellent English communication and customer-handling skills.

**Preferred:** MSP experience and international voice-based technical support experience.

Join our team to manage IT infrastructure and support global clients using diverse technologies.
